title: Offline matching demonstration
instructions: Match each concept to its description.

pairs.right: Pumps blood through the circulatory system.
pairs.explanation: Heart: Pumps blood through the circulatory system.

pairs.right: Exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide between air and blood.
pairs.explanation: Lungs: Exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide between air and blood.

pairs.right: Mixes food with acid and enzymes to begin substantial protein digestion.
pairs.explanation: Stomach: Mixes food with acid and enzymes to begin substantial protein digestion.

pairs.right: Filter blood and regulate water and salts by producing urine.
pairs.explanation: Kidneys: Filter blood and regulate water and salts by producing urine.

pairs.right: Produces bile, which helps disperse fats during digestion.
pairs.explanation: Liver: Produces bile, which helps disperse fats during digestion.

pairs.right: Secretes digestive enzymes into the small intestine and releases insulin into blood.
pairs.explanation: Pancreas: Secretes digestive enzymes into the small intestine and releases insulin into blood.
